name: Hotel Dorfplatzl
beschreibung:
Overview

The Aparthotel Dorfplatzl is a 4-star apart-hotel with hotel service in the centre of Tux-Vorderlanersbach in the Zillertal. It is run by the Gredler family in the third generation; the operator is Oswald Gredler GmbH. The rooms and apartments range from 20 to 80 m² and offer space for one to eight people; single rooms, double rooms, a suite and several apartments are available. Variety under one roof defines the house: the in-house Pizzeria Platzl, the miniM supermarket, a newly renovated wellness area with Finnish and bio sauna including a relaxation room, a fitness room with Technogym equipment and a children's playroom are part of the accommodation. Daily room cleaning, Wi-Fi and free parking with an e-car charging station are part of the offer.

History/Background

The history of the site goes back to 1926, when grandfather Alois Gredler and his mother opened the “Bormerloden”, a general store. In 1954 Alois Gredler was among the founders of Spar Tirol-Salzburg; a little later the grocery store was expanded and converted to self-service; at the same time the first guest rooms began to be rented out for summer holidays in the Tuxer Hochtal. In 1976 son Oswald took over the business, the house was given the name Dorfplatzl, and the combination of apartments, rooms, pizzeria and supermarket came into being. Since 2007 Ossi Gredler has worked in the family business, and Nina joined in 2012. In 2016 the supermarket was converted into a miniM of the MPreis retail chain, in 2017 the neighbouring Dorfhütte building was demolished and the apart-hotel extended, and in 2019 the reception area was finally redesigned and the Pizzeria Platzl enlarged.

Getting There

By car, the route leads via the Inntal autobahn A12, exit Zillertal, then on the B169 for around 30 km through the valley to Mayrhofen and via the Tuxertal turn-off through Finkenberg to Tux-Vorderlanersbach. Around 70 m after the town sign, the hotel is on the right-hand side on the village square after a sharp right-hand bend; in the cold season, winter equipment is recommended for the vehicle. By train, Jenbach is the long-distance railway station; from there take the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen and continue by bus to Tux-Vorderlanersbach. The bus stop is directly next to the house. For air travel, the house organises an airport shuttle from Innsbruck, Salzburg or Munich on request.

Tips

Check-in is possible from 15:00, check-out until 10:30. Breakfast is served from 07:30 to 09:30 and is included for rooms and suites, and can be added for apartments. A tourist tax of € 2.60 per person per day is charged additionally. The house is a non-smoking hotel; for dogs € 20 per night is charged. Ski passes, ski equipment as well as mountain and e-bikes are organised by the team on request. The Pizzeria Platzl is open from 17:00 to 21:30; the Happy Hour from 17:00 to 18:00 offers every pizza at the price of € 9.9.

Best Time to Travel

The Tuxer Tal is suitable for a stay all year round. In winter the focus is on skiing, cross-country skiing, tobogganing and winter and snowshoe hiking, while in summer it is hiking, mountain biking, e-mountain biking, golf, climbing and paragliding. The apart-hotel is conveniently located close to the lift and bus stop, so the surrounding ski areas are easily accessible.
